title: Mixed Event — Singing Among the Cherry Blossoms — Episode8 Meeting As They Bloom

meta.Event Outline: Ichika continues her singing practice with Nene in the hopes of improving as much as possible for Shiho. She decides to try performing on the street in order to gain more confidence, but what unexpected encounter awaits her there...?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: S-Sorry, Miku! Could you hide for a second?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What brings you here? Are you on your way home from something?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes. Minori and I were out doing a little shopping.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Then we started hearing this beautiful singing voice, and we came to see who it was...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Does this mean that you were the one singing that Miku song, Ichika?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wow! I never knew you were so good at singing!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, Ichika! Would you mind if I sang with you?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! Your singing made me want to sing too!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Me too...!
How about we all sing together?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I guess I should head home now that I've finished delivering a change of clothes to the hospital.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I was at least hoping to see dad today but...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I need to get back to cleaning up our new song. After that...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: How could I have gotten our meeting time wrong?! I'm a future star for pete's sake!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That was close. We almost just headbutted each other... Please accept my apology!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Thank goodness!
Wait, now's not the time...!
I have to get ready for the show!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
That was strange.
He was so loud too...
Hm?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Oh, there are people singing in the park.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (They're singing in unison and their voices all seem to complement one another...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Kohane, Ichika!
Would it be okay if we sang one more song?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yes. I was about to ask the same thing.
How about you, Azusawa?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Of course! This is so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Hehe. You're right.
Do you have something in mind, Hanasato?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Would you mind calling me by my first name?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I never found the right time to ask you, but I feel like we've gotten to know each other a lot better by singing together like this so...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It's okay. You can call me the same way Saki does!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Th-Then...
Can you do the same for me?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hehe. This is great!
We became much, much closer just like that!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, right!
How about we try that Miku song everyone's been talking about?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: The one everyone's been... Oh, got it!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Okay, here we go.
One, two...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Practicing with everyone and doing street performances is fun too, but this is really something else.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I never knew that singing could be fun and enjoyed in so many different ways.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (That person... Are they listening to us sing?)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Then let's put on a good show for them.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Oh, they left, but I think they were smiling at the end...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Maybe we're not quite there yet. I need to keep practicing and keep getting better...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Um, Miku...
Your music just helped me become friends with Minori and Kohane.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yes.
I've talked with them before about it and I even met Kohane while she was singing one of your songs.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Your songs have such incredible powers...
Not only did they help bring my old friends back together, they're helping me make new ones as well.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I've been able to meet so many new faces, thanks to you.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
So... Thank you.
I'm so glad I met you, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <You were the one that found out what your true feelings were, and you made it here all on your own.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Right...
So that we can all stay together as one...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: These cherry blossoms really are beautiful, aren't they...?
